anti_commodity_copy_rewrite.ota_headline: No5 Boutique Art Hotel by Mantis: Art-Deco Luxury & Coastal Serenity in Summerstrand
anti_commodity_copy_rewrite.property_overview_150_words: Nestled in Gqeberha's affluent Summerstrand, No5 Boutique Art Hotel by Mantis is an immaculately restored Art-Deco sanctuary. Home to over 200 authentic South African artworks, it offers a unique blend of cultural immersion and coastal tranquility. Guests enjoy elegant suites, a fine dining restaurant, private cinema, and a serene outdoor pool, all within a short stroll of pristine blue flag beaches. Experience personalized service and a refined atmosphere, perfect for discerning art lovers and those seeking a luxurious escape near the Indian Ocean.
